input.title: Give the FAQ search field an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale: The search input (#faq-search) has no accessible name. The visible text "Search questions" is in a <label> on line 10, but that label has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the input, so it isn't linked to the field. I can only edit the input itself, so this patch adds aria-label="Search questions". It uses the same words as the visible label, so screen reader users and voice control users get the same name sighted users see. A better fix would be to edit the source and add for="faq-search" to the <label> on line 10. That makes the link native and lets users click the label text to focus the field. If you make that change, you can drop the aria-label. Please re-test after applying either fix.
